name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-seo
description: Quartz 5 plugin for what search engines and feed readers see: noindex on private pages, canonical URLs, article metadata and JSON-LD, the sitemap and the RSS feed. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: head elements must be the host's Preact vnodes. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild inlines tags-core (our library) and reading-time (v4's reading-time counter) into dist (build.mjs), so the published package, which ships only dist/, needs none of them. tags-core is a `workspace:*` spec, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005). It is a library, not the quartz-tags engine, so inlining it adds no plugin dependency. @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs).
